statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment.
The service was to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
The diagnosis codes were R00.2 and R42.
The denial reason code was CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered.
